short.en: Add a gate outside the part

t.zh: 路线不能经过石头：石头格的路线数是「—」。
t.en: Routes can’t pass through rocks: a rock cell has “—” routes.

goal.zh: 数出每个路口的路线数，石头格不算。
goal.en: Count the routes to every crossing, rock cells left out.

how.zh: 用路线计数器数，拦截闸在石头格拦下结果。
how.en: Count with the Route Counter, and block the result on rock cells.

body.zh: 元件不用改，外面加一道闸就够了。
body.en: The part stays as it is; a gate outside it is enough.

hints.zh: 「是石头」接拦截闸的条件口，路线计数器接数口。
hints.en: Wire “is rock” to the Block gate’s condition and the Route Counter into its number.
